title: Trump vs. the electric catapult
caption:
Steam versus electromagnets: the US Navy's most expensive argument. Dave lost either way. ✈️
A carrier catapult flings a jet to take-off speed in about a hundred metres, with steam on older ships or electromagnets on the USS Gerald R. Ford.
Team steam or team electric?
sources: TIME interview with Donald Trump, May 2017 (on EMALS: "You have to be Albert Einstein to figure it out"; told the Navy to go back to steam)
US DoD Director, Operational Test & Evaluation annual reports (EMALS reliability problems on CVN-78 Gerald R. Ford)
